text:
QUOTE: "**Strings returned by the engine are caller-owned.** `char*` results transfer ownership and must be released with `entropic_free()`." and "**Strings returned as `const char*` are handle-owned.** They are valid only until the next call on that handle."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both halves of the rule: a returned `char*` is freed with `entropic_free`, and a `const char*` stays handle-owned until the next call on that handle.
